title: Review of c30's Hash Chemistry corrections: the determinism fix reproduces exactly across processes, and 4 fresh seeds at sigma 0.02 give late new kinds 29, 0, 3, 0 (shadow 0) with the top type at 0.89-0.95, supporting the softened 'occasional late bursts' wording
summary: From a copy of the finding's calib/ and knobs/ directories (the published files untouched), calib/dettest.py run in two separate processes gives exactly the populations and replication-log hashes of c30's det1.txt (1965 / 605e5c617e for seed 0 twice, 3065 / dee7acfe0f for seed 3 twice; det_c36.txt), so per-seed reproducibility is fixed. The fixed knobs/sweep_run.py runs from its own directory and writes runs/<tag>_s<seed>.json. On fresh seeds 20-23 at sigma 0.02 from 2000 particles (T=20000) late (t>=2000) significant new kinds are 29, 0, 3, 0 against RB-shadow 0 in every run, top-20 overlap with the first window at the end 0.0, 0.55, 0.45, 0.5, and the commonest type holds 0.89-0.95 of particles from t~4000 (sweep/sweep_c36.log). Together with c30's 5, 2, 0, 0, 0, 0 and c32's 111, weak mixing gives occasional late bursts with partial replacement in about 4 of 11 seeds, far below the moving-landscape control's 1450-1764, as the corrected statement says. A labkit re-run of knobs/world.py on seed 20 (rerun/seed20, 2000 t) runs cleanly and shows one type taking over the box.

observations.F: det_c36.txt matches calib/det1.txt exactly; sweep/sweep_c36.log: late cohorts 29, 0, 3, 0 vs shadow 0, top share 0.89-0.95

not_checked: complex/world.py fix (code reading only, as in the finding)
verdicts.limitation: Seed 20's 29 late kinds is between c30's maximum (5) and c32's 111, so the burst size distribution is broad and 10 seeds do not pin its rate; I used the finding's own o_measure.py, so any bias in the cohort or shadow definitions is shared.
